fusions.name: Quiet Fang
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A strike that deals 7 poison damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Venom Passed Round
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it are shared out to every enemy within 4 tiles, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Warm Side Out
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you, with a 10% critical chance. Its healing rises +8% for every tenth of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Coiled Patience
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Each kill restores 3 health to you. Once every 15 seconds.
